Method of Attack: Cryptocurrency mixing to launder proceeds from hackers, ransomware gangs, and scammers

Facilitated laundering of 152,000 Bitcoins (~EUR 2.73 billion) connected to dark web markets, ransomware groups, illicit goods trafficking, child sexual exploitation material, and stolen crypto assets
Impacted Systems: Ransomware groups including LockBit, Zeppelin, SunCrypt, Mamba, Dharma
Indicators of Compromise: Seizure of four servers, 7 TB of data, and $46.5 million worth of Bitcoin
Seizure banner from Germany's BKA on ChipMixer's Tor dark web servers
Ties to dark web market Hydra infrastructure seized in April 2022
Use of ChipMixer by ransomware groups to launder ransom payments
Indications of laundering assets stolen from a large cryptocurrency exchange following bankruptcy
